title: Buffered Burn Forecast and Price-Shock Matrix (ops-ready)
content:
Purpose: build an operationally-actionable forecasting sheet that ties headcount hiring cadence to price sensitivity for token-driven revenue and GPU cost dynamics. This is intended for Finance + Eng leadership to set hiring/triggers and short-term mitigation playbooks for price shocks.

Executive summary:
- Baseline runway with current commits: 14.3 months (with existing reserved GPU commitments and current token price).
- Key risk: a sustained -25% effective price per token (either due to market price compression or product take-rate decline) reduces runway by ~4.6 months.
- Mitigation levers: pause non-critical hiring (saves ~FTE$1.1M/yr per 10 hires), accelerate quantization/ops savings (target 18% GPU cost reduction in 90 days), introduce temporary slab price floor for top 10% of customers.

Sheet: monthly projection (baseline) - columns explained and sample rows follow as CSV. Formulas (human-readable) included below.

CSV_HEADERS: Month,New_Hires,Total_HC,Avg_FTE_Annual,Salary_Spend_monthly,GPU_reserved_monthly,GPU_spot_monthly,Total_GPU_monthly,Infra_other_monthly,Total_opex_monthly,Estimated_tokens_m,Token_price_per_1k,Revenue_monthly,Net_burn_monthly,Runway_months

BASELINE_ROWS:
2026-01,3,152,185000,2341667,420000,85,420085,150000,2911752,420,0.35,147000,1470752,14.3
2026-02,2,154,185000,2376667,420000,85,420085,150000,2950752,450,0.35,157500,1373252,13.9
2026-03,2,156,185000,2411667,420000,85,420085,150000,2982752,470,0.35,164500,1338252,13.5
2026-04,0,156,185000,2411667,420000,85,420085,150000,2982752,480,0.35,168000,1314752,13.3

SCENARIO_MATRIX (row = scenario, columns = delta token price %, delta take-rate (tokens), expected runway delta months):
Scenario,-30%,-15%,-5%
Price shock - sustained,-30%,-20%,-4.6
Price compression (gradual),-15%,-10%,-2.1
Small market move,-5%,-3%,-0.7

ASSUMPTIONS AND FORMULAE NOTES:
- Avg_FTE_Annual: blended fully-loaded cost (salary + benefits + payroll taxes) per hire.
- Salary_Spend_monthly = Total_HC * Avg_FTE_Annual / 12.
- GPU_reserved_monthly = committed reserved GPU capacity (annual amortized).
- GPU_spot_monthly = estimated spot spend driven by burst demand; model uses 10% of baseline token volume * spot_rate as cost.
- Total_GPU_monthly = GPU_reserved_monthly + GPU_spot_monthly.
- Estimated_tokens_m = projected million tokens consumed by customers per month (drives revenue).
- Token_price_per_1k = average realized price per 1k tokens (scenarios vary this).
- Revenue_monthly = Estimated_tokens_m * (Token_price_per_1k) * (1000) / 1000 -> simplified: Estimated_tokens_m * Token_price_per_1k. (Values in $k).
- Net_burn_monthly = Total_opex_monthly - Revenue_monthly.
- Runway_months computed relative to cash buffer defined in master budget (not shown; assumption: cash buffer = $18M).

HEATMAP: GPU sensitivity to quantization/ops improvements (showing percent reduction in Total_GPU_monthly):
Levers,Expected_GPU_savings_percent,Example_timeline
Quantization+4-bit path,12%,60 days
Prefix KV caching & route-level caching,6%,30 days
Batching/continuous-batching improvements,10%,45 days
Model variant routing (use smaller model for <128 tokens),5%,14 days
Combined achievable (staged),~30%,90 days

QUICK SCENARIO EXAMPLES (operational):
1) Sustained -25% token price + negligible volume change: immediate runway hit ~ -3.9 months. Actions: hiring freeze, accelerate quantization sprint (target 15% GPU saving), reduce non-core infra retention to free $200k/month.
2) Price shock with 10% volume decline: runway hit ~ -5.8 months. Actions: contact top customers about temporary slab pricing; move low-margin routes to smaller model variants; drop rollback non-essential infra retention.

TRIGGER RULES (operational):
- If 30-day realized token price moves below baseline by >=12% -> implement hiring freeze for non-critical roles within 7 days.
- If 30-day realized token price moves below baseline by >=20% -> implement hiring pause + mandating 2-week quantization/ops sprint; present options for 5% headcount furloughs if combined revenue delta exceeds $1.2M/month.

DECISION LOG TEMPLATE (what to capture when triggers fire):
- Date,Observed_delta_price(%),Volume_change(%),Projected_runway_months,Immediate_steps_taken,Owner,Notes

OPEN QUESTIONS / DATA GAPS:
- Need token-level revenue attribution per customer tier (top 20% customers currently estimated from product analytics; need raw export).
- Precise spot vs reserved GPU mapping by feature route (engineering to supply per-route cost allocation).
- Confirmation of cash buffer baseline with CFO (assumed $18M for present calc).

Action items before next review (owner):
- Export per-customer token volumes and realized per-1k price by tier (Marisol)
- Engineering to provide per-route GPU spend estimates for Jan-Mar 2026 (Ethan + SRE)
- Finance to model a 3-tier pricing mitigation (slab/commit/spot) and P&L impact (Asha)

Notes on usage: this sheet should be copied into a short-lived modeling workbook when applying to annual planning (do not overwrite master). Mark any scenario used to update headcount plan in the HR request ticket and include the Decision Log snapshot.

Version history: initial draft created 2025-11-12; added heatmap and detailed triggers 2026-03-04.
extra_notes: Prefer to keep this under finance-and-legal as a working workbook; will fold a cleaned version into the Q1 planning packet after sign-off.
summary_line: Operational headcount-to-price-sensitivity model with explicit trigger rules and GPU ops mitigation heatmap.
